extension.summary: Thirteen skins for Kodi 21 Omega, designed for the TV.
extension.description: Majan, Void, Orbit, Daylight, Duotone, Sentence, Passe-partout, Nocturne, Six Degrees, Fold, Keepsake, Groove and Vernissage: skins designed for the TV and tested on an NVIDIA Shield, plus two optional helper add-ons. Install a skin from this repository and its updates arrive automatically.
